function: Localization and velocity estimation of targets from compressed sensing echoes (pp. 1, 7); beamforming is fixed MMSE, so no beams, waveforms or resources are learned (p. 5).
notes: Excluded for function (reviewer to confirm). The only learned element, the D-VQVAE, compresses the received sensing echoes at each AP and estimates target location and velocity at the CPU (p. 1 abstract; p. 7: "The CPU uses a decoder to estimate the location and velocity of the targets"). Transmit beamforming is a fixed centralized MMSE design and p. 5 footnote 1 says "we focus on target sensing given a fixed transmit beamforming design", so no beams, waveforms or resources are learned (area 5), and the compressed signals are sensing echoes, not the communication channel (area 2). Borderline: the system also serves K users (p. 4), so a reviewer who counts learned sensing inside an ISAC system as area 5 would include it.
